Provide estimated total payable amount.

But they just want estimate. So we need to compute cost. Also maybe need to consider insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

1. Call list_all_airports to get list. 
2. Determine first and last airport codes. 
3. Call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business".

Return cost. Then respond with estimated total payable amount.

We need to call the function.
